source: Run records of dev.orazaka.com (GET /api/v1/studios/runs/{id}: start and finish of each run) joined with the output file (ffprobe) and the engine's own log (stable-diffusion.cpp `generate_image completed in`). Exported by hand after the session; re-measure when the setup changes.

setup.machine: MacBook Pro, Apple M1 Max, 64 GB unified memory (Metal)
setup.platform: Orazaka dev (DigitalOcean App Platform, Toronto) — core, relay, broker; the Mac joins through the GPU relay (chisel over TLS)

parameters.size: 832×480 (fixed by the provider: 720×1280, 480×832 and 1280×720 were all answered at 832×480)

not exposed by the provider's API

events.what: Wan 2.2 A14B refused the first call (403)
events.cause: the model access key did not list the model; an all-models key fixed it

events.what: Wan 2.2 A14B cannot make 9:16
events.cause: every size asked (720×1280, 480×832, 1280×720, with or without aspect_ratio/resolution) came back 832×480; the model is refused for 9:16 by name rather than cropped

events.what: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B on the Mac (480×832, 25 frames)
events.cause: MPS out of memory while decoding (26 GiB of MPS, 62 GiB held by other allocations on a 64 GB machine)

events.what: three video runs took 264 s, 439 s and 1 063 s instead of about 130 s
events.cause: the Mac worker had lost its tunnel and restarted; the jobs waited in the queue (their times are left out of the statistics)

events.what: openai-gpt-image-2 refused (403)
events.cause: not available for this subscription tier (tried once)

events.what: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large: first Orazaka runs returned a 1×1 transparent image
events.cause: the provider's base URL lacked /v1 (the client appends /images/generations): 404, then a transparent fallback; fixed with the provider do-inference-images

events.what: FLUX.2 [klein] returned a 1×1 placeholder on several runs (server room and notary desk on every attempt; neon arcade twice)
events.cause: the image client gives up waiting through the relay (about 2 minutes) while the engine needed 60–75 s plus the transfer of a 2.5 MB image; a web deploy also restarts the relay and drops the tunnel

events.what: two FLUX.2 images (server room, notary desk) were produced in about 62 s each, then lost
events.cause: later retries wrote placeholders over the same file names before they were published (a process mistake, now guarded by checking the size of each download)

events.what: Z-Image Turbo at 1024×1024 was dropped
events.cause: the engine needs about 157 s per image (8 steps at about 18 s each), longer than the client waits

events.what: DigitalOcean GPUs: the 48 GB sizes (L40S, RTX 6000 Ada) were never in stock; the 20 GB RTX 4000 Ada appeared and disappeared (3 starts, 2 refused for stock)
events.cause: sold out in tor1, the only region the private broker's VPC reaches

events.what: ten clips in a row failed in 17 s (HTTP 500) after the first one succeeded
events.cause: the worker's free-RAM pre-flight counted the first clip's resident pipeline (~22 GB) against the next job (fixed: no pre-flight for a resident pipeline, orazaka-worker-media#22)

events.what: three clips (up to 9 minutes of GPU each) were lost mid-render
events.cause: every deploy of dev.orazaka.com restarts the relay: the worker's AMQP stream dropped and the process exited (fixed: the consumer reconnects and skips a redelivered job, orazaka-worker-media#24)

events.what: several runs failed with 404 on their starting photo
events.cause: the platform keeps uploads on the core's disk, which a redeploy wipes; the batch runner uploads the photo again (media durable on Bunny is krizaka/orazaka#144)

events.what: the droplet's watchdog destroyed an idle droplet (1.2 h) while the laptop that drove the batch was asleep
events.cause: 30 min without a job; the batch runner now resumes a run in flight from its ticket

events.what: Wan 2.2 A14B at 720p cannot be resident on one 80 GB card
events.cause: two bf16 experts are 57 GB; with the activations of 1280×720 the card is full, so the experts are offloaded to the host and swapped (~26 s a step, ~18 min a clip)

events.what: the RunPod pod kept billing about two hours after its last job
events.cause: its in-pod watchdog destroys the pod through the RunPod API and the pod has no API key of its own; a guard loop on the maintainer's machine ended it (to fix: a restricted key for the pod, or stop from the driver as soon as the queue is empty)

events.what: the first 720p run failed: cached snapshot incomplete
events.cause: the fetch pattern list had transformer/* but not the second expert transformer_2/* (fixed, orazaka-worker-media#27)

events.what: three Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B attempts of the mint-tea pour were rejected on review
events.cause: the stream missed the glass, the glass doubled, the teapot drifted — the subject was replaced rather than a bad clip shown

events.what: Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large candidates were rejected on review (21 of the 48 images are the ones kept or compared)
events.cause: a smeared glass-like haze over the face of the tea pourer, a mushy hologram; 1024×1024 is the only size the provider makes, so each kept image is cut to 16:9

events.what: one finished clip could not be downloaded (404) and was run again
events.cause: the platform keeps outputs on the core's disk, which a redeploy of dev wipes (durable media: krizaka/orazaka#144)

events.what: the 720p text-to-video clip « City at night, neon in the rain » was rejected (a neon sign read as gibberish letters despite « no lettering »); « Acoustic guitar by the fire » replaced it
events.cause: Wan 2.2 A14B draws signage on neon scenes; the text gate caught it on the frame grid

events.what: the image-to-video clip of the snowy Plateau street drifted in colour on two seeds (grey first frame, then a saturated copper wall); its first ten frames were cut
events.cause: the model re-exposes the starting image within the first 0.6 s; the rest of the clip is consistent

events.what: LTX-2 (native high resolution) was not run
events.cause: its checkpoint is 25 GB in fp8 but the repository publishes a 93 GB text encoder, more than the pod's free disk, and its licence is the LTX-2 Community License (free under $10M annual revenue, a paid agreement above) — a licence to read before it is a default

events.what: Wan 2.2 A14B image-to-video needs its own 106 GB checkpoint
events.cause: text and image are two checkpoints of the family; the network volume has 35 GB free, so it is fetched to the pod's container disk each session (2 minutes) instead of a recurring volume

events.what: the first Wan 2.2 bake-off run (18 minutes of GPU) finished but was lost
events.cause: the bake script saved numpy frames as if they were PIL images (output_type); fixed (output_type=pil) and run again

events.what: HunyuanVideo 1.5 720p image-to-video was stopped after 19 of 50 steps
events.cause: 90 s a step with model offload (75 GB resident), about 75 minutes a clip; its licence also excludes the EU, UK and South Korea

events.what: every Studio run on dev answered HTTP 500 for about 30 minutes
events.cause: the billing service's connection pool regression (« This connection has been closed »); the pod was kept idle then, and the runs restarted once the fix was live

events.what: the first LTX runs failed in the worker (three causes, one after the other)
events.cause: the weights were on the host's own disk and the loader did not look there; the tokenizer needs tiktoken, protobuf and imageio; the upscale asked ffmpeg to crop 1920 pixels from a 1865-pixel-wide picture (LTX makes 1216×704, narrower than 16:9). Fixed in orazaka-worker-media#43

RunPod pod (the 5B image-to-video batch of the home page, the 720p heroes, the first upscaler tests; ended by the spend guard once idle)
RunPod pod (six directed image-to-video clips with Wan 2.2 A14B, one retried, the 1080p/4K passes, the Orochia hero; stopped by id when done)

fastest, but the 4K keeps the grain: not chosen
winner — clean detail without grain, temporally stable; 480p sources (the Orochia feed) become convincing HD
winner — the default of the Studio's `upscale: 1080p` step
winner — 4K holds (tiled VAE, 31 GB): `upscale: 2160p`, for a hero
not run: weights larger than the pod's free disk; licence conditions to read first

bakeOff.note: The same FLUX.2 [klein] still made at the video's own aspect through the image-generation Studio (1360×768 and 768×1360; Studio runs c3efac13-6c5b-4743-af3b-e856204f3d96 and 12cee392-9a0e-4a18-a496-44bf0d324c8a), the same motion-only prompt and negatives, the same seed. Direct diffusers runs on the pod, not Studio runs. Landscape: a cable car in the Alps at dawn (a dolly-in is asked); 9:16: a woman and a golden retriever walking in the snow (motion and anatomy)

the best anatomy: a natural gait, the dog's tail, the coat; no warped limb
the winner: sharp, the dolly-in is obeyed, 80× faster than Wan
a good preview: natural walk, but a dark boot-sole artefact on two frames
